purpose: Teach: 巫女/出土/事変/病原/徴候/定式/諸氏/カルテル

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、神社の、絶対、巫女、絶対、関係者、絶対、警察、絶対、聴取、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've completed our interview with the shrine personnel involved in this case. I appreciate your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured and official but not cold. Steady eye contact. Each clause lands with quiet authority. Slight breath between sentences—he's delivering information, not reading from a script.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古墳から、本気で、絶対、出土、絶対、した、絶対、品、絶対、警察、絶対、保管、絶対、されていますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the items excavated from the burial mound are being held in police custody, then?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity underneath careful politeness. Leans in slightly with the question. Not interrogating—trying to understand the sequence. A student who actually wants to know, not perform knowing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。歴史的な、本気で、絶対、事変、絶対、現場、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're conducting regular patrols of the historical site as part of the ongoing investigation.
lines.style: Procedural tone, clear and unbureaucratic despite the formal content. No rush. He's explaining because it matters that Ren understands, not because protocol requires saying it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の、本気で、絶対、病原、絶対、菌、絶対、感染、絶対、警察、絶対、確認、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And the victim's pathogenic exposure—the police have verified that connection?
lines.style: Tentative but not uncertain. He's connecting pieces aloud, checking his own reasoning as much as asking for confirmation. Quieter than the previous question—more internal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件の、本気で、絶対、徴候、絶対、警察、絶対、早期、絶対、察知、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We detected the early indicators of this incident and acted accordingly.
lines.style: Calm assertion. Not defensive—just factual. A slight emphasis on 'early' to underscore competence without boasting. The tone of someone who knows his work was sound.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 捜査の、本気で、絶対、定式、絶対、化、絶対、警察、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the investigation is being systematized and formalized as you move forward?
lines.style: Quieter inflection now. He's not asking for more—he's thinking aloud, almost to himself. A pause before the question, like he's assembling the implications in real time.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。専門家、本気で、絶対、諸氏、絶対、警察、絶対、ご助言、絶対、頂いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're receiving guidance from specialists as the work progresses.
lines.style: Measured and clear. A slight nod of acknowledgment embedded in the tone—he respects the professionals involved. Professional warmth without softness. Each word carries its own weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 企業間の、本気で、絶対、カルテル、絶対、警察、絶対、調査、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And you're investigating the possibility of collusion between the companies involved?
lines.style: Final question, delivered with careful restraint. Lower in register than before. He's asking something weightier now, and his voice reflects that—less curious, more grave. A full stop at the end, not a trailing rise.
